attributes.action: Require fair and transparent all-inclusive holiday pricing for children under 10
attributes.additional_details:
Families booking holidays are increasingly presented with all-inclusive prices where young children appear to be charged the same “per person” price as adults.

We believe this deserves greater transparency and scrutiny, particularly for children under 10.

A young child does not have the same needs, consumption or use of services as an adult. For example, children do not consume alcohol and may have significantly different food consumption and use of adult-oriented facilities and services.
attributes.background: Require the Government to investigate the pricing of all-inclusive package holidays for children under 10 and introduce measures to ensure that child prices are transparent, age-appropriate and proportionate to the services provided to children.

rejection.details: This is a matter for holiday companies.
